steps.name: source-preflight
steps.command: git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git branch --show-current && test -f frontend/package.json && command -v rsync && command -v ssh

steps.name: raspberry-pi-runtime-preflight
steps.command: ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && systemctl is-active photomap.service cloudflared.service && systemctl show photomap.service cloudflared.service -p MainPID && sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html && free -m && df -Pm . && curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health && echo && curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "API_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map'
